_doc: Finding the town's secrets (T-0068, docs/design/discoveries.md). search is a place interaction (target "place"): done where you stand, on that place's lot; when it finishes it uncovers a secret you have the clue for (right place and time), or teaches the clue of one that doesn't need it, or finds nothing. teaches_clue: doing it teaches that discovery's clue (notice boards, T-0070). Free will doesn't search (empty advertise).
